doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecasts and Interim Dividend (Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase)
doc_title_jp: 「業績予想の修正」並びに「剰余金の配当（中間配当・増配）」および「期末配当予想の修正（増配）」に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 貸出金利息および有価証券利息配当金が当初予想を上回ることが主因

summary_en: The Bank of Iwate raised its fiscal 2027 interim dividend to 33 yen per share from 29 yen, and revised its full-year dividend forecast to 67 yen per share from 58 yen, reflecting upward earnings revisions driven by stronger-than-expected loan interest income and securities income.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の中間配当を29円から33円に、期末配当予想を29円から34円に増配。通期配当は58円から67円に。貸出金利息と有価証券利息配当金が予想を上回ったことが主因。
